DATED: 15/03/2023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CIVIL APPLICATION NO. 781 of 2020 ==========================================================
 LH OF DECD. RAMABHAI JOITARAM PATEL  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT ==========================================================
Appearance:
MR TEJAS P SATTA(3149) for the Petitioner(s) No. 1,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5 MR SAHIL TRIVEDI, ASST GOVERNMENT PLEADER for the Respondent(s)
No. 1,2 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR.
 JUSTICE A.J.DESAI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIREN VAISHNAV  Date : 15/03/2023  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE A.J.DESAI)
1. By way of the present petition, the petitioners have prayed for the following prayers:
"8.
A. Issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, direction or order in the nature of mandamus and direct the respondent authorities to expeditiously pay to the petitioners the land compensation amount as derived in the final award dated 31.07.2017 passed in LAR case No. 1636/11 in main LAR Case No. 1620/2001 in group of LAR Case No. 1620/2011 to 1713/2011 by the Hon'ble 3rd Addl.
C/SCA/781/2020 ORDER DATED: 15/03/2023 Senior Civil Judge, Mehsana.

sentences.text:
Issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, direction or order in the nature of mandamus and direct the respondent authorities to calculate afresh the Solatium amount as per the Section 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and pay the Solatium amount to the petitioners.
C. Issue writ of mandamus or any other appropriate writ, direction or order in the nature of mandamus and direct the respondent authorities to calculate afresh the payable interest amount as per the Section 80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and pay the payable interest so calculated to the petitioners."

2. It is the grievance of the petitioners that though the possession of the land has been taken over under acquisition for construction of bypass road of city of Mehsana way back in the year 2010, no proceedings under the Land Acquisition Act have been initiated qua the lands in question.
It is the grievance of the petitioners that the possession of the land which belongs to the petitioners was taken by the respondent authority.
Incorrect number of the land was referred in the award.

It is also the case of the petitioners that since 2010,
the petitioners are without any fruits of the acquisition proceedings due to the mistake committed by the respondent authority.

Mr. Tejas Satta, learned advocate for the petitioners would therefore submit that the respondent authority be directed to complete the acquisition proceedings and also be directed to pass appropriate award.

3. On the other hand, Mr. Sahil Trivedi, learned AGP appearing for the respondent State, under instructions, would state that through oversight and bonafide mistake, the land belonging to the petitioners though acquired, the proceedings could not be completed.
He would submit that the mistake shall be corrected after following due procedure including declaration of award within six months from today.

4. Having heard learned advocates for the respective parties and considering the issue, the respondents are hereby directed to complete the acquisition proceedings C/SCA/781/2020 ORDER DATED: 15/03/2023 as early as possible preferably within six months from today and shall declare the award on or before 15.09.2023.
With the said direction, petition is disposed of.
(A.J.DESAI, ACJ) (BIREN VAISHNAV, J) DIVYA Lh Of Decd.
